experiences_age_rule_limits.name: experiences_age_rule_limits
experiences_age_rule_limits.value:
(
        "experiences"."age_rule" IN ('all_ages', 'twenty_one_plus')
          AND "experiences"."min_age" IS NULL AND "experiences"."max_age" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "experiences"."age_rule" = 'minimum_age'
          AND "experiences"."min_age" IS NOT NULL AND "experiences"."min_age" >= 0
          AND "experiences"."max_age" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "experiences"."age_rule" = 'age_range'
          AND "experiences"."min_age" IS NOT NULL AND "experiences"."min_age" >= 0
          AND "experiences"."max_age" IS NOT NULL AND "experiences"."max_age" >= "experiences"."min_age"
      )

experiences_weather_decision_hours.name: experiences_weather_decision_hours
experiences_weather_decision_hours.value:
coalesce("experiences"."weather_policy" = 'decided_before_start', false)
        = ("experiences"."weather_decision_hours" IS NOT NULL)
        AND coalesce("experiences"."weather_decision_hours" > 0, true)

collections_intro_is_rich_text.name: collections_intro_is_rich_text
collections_intro_is_rich_text.value:
"collections"."intro" IS NULL OR (jsonb_typeof("collections"."intro") = 'object'
    AND coalesce("collections"."intro"->>'type', '') = 'doc'
    AND coalesce(jsonb_typeof("collections"."intro"->'content'), '') = 'array'
    AND octet_length("collections"."intro"::text) <= 200000)
